name: Nature Spirit Base
notes: Chassis for Nature Spirits: place-bound guardian beings tied to a specific natural seat (grove, spring, hill, marsh, etc.). Provides identity Tags and Traits. Domain / Motivation / Loadout / Quirk ChangeSets layer on top to specialise the spirit.

name: Beast Base
notes: Chassis for Beasts: dangerous natural animals (wolves, bears, boars, great cats, etc.) driven by hunger, fear, territory, or pack instinct. Provides identity Tags and Traits plus three default powers. Pack-Hunter / Brute-Predator / Ambush-Hunter / Scavenger ChangeSets layer on top to specialise.

name: Hidden Folk Base
notes: Chassis for Hidden Folk: elder parallel people occupying the land beside humanity, dangerous through glamour, influence, and folklore-law rather than violence. Provides identity Tags and Traits plus three default powers. Hill / Hearth / Wood / Water ChangeSets layer on top to specialise.

name: Undead Base
notes: Chassis for Undead: beings that failed to pass out of the world in death (revenants, draugr, ghosts, hauntings, fetches, etc.). Provides identity Tags and Traits plus three default powers. Restless / Ghost / Unquiet / Living-Dead / Haunting / Fetch ChangeSets layer on top to specialise.

name: Cursed Base
notes: Chassis for Cursed beings: creatures transformed by curse, witchcraft, or corrupt generation (werewolves, basilisks, witch-made animals, strigoi, etc.). Provides identity Tags and Traits plus three default powers. Bestial / Petrifying / Venomous / Moon-Bound / Familiar / Monstrous-Generation ChangeSets layer on top.

name: The Unseen Base
notes: Chassis for The Unseen: singular elder powers of the Hidden Folk civilization (Jinn, Lady of the Lake, Sidhe nobles, Erlking, Frau Holle, Wild Hunt leaders). Provides identity Tags and Traits plus four default powers. Courtly / Water Sovereign / Winter Matron / Hunt Master / Smokeless Fire ChangeSets layer on top.

name: Unnatural Base
notes: Chassis for Unnaturals: outsider entities (devils, demons, angels, soul-drinkers, possessors, messengers) from another existence brought into the world by summoning, breach, invitation, or unlawful passage. Provides identity Tags and Traits plus three default powers. Angelic / Infernal / Demonic / Tempter / Possessor / Familiar / Soul Drinker / Messenger / Commander ChangeSets layer on top.

name: Construct Base
notes: Chassis for Constructs: made beings (golems, homunculi, animated guardians, laboratory things, crafted servitors) given force, motion, and purpose by human or nonhuman craft. Provides identity Tags and Traits plus three default powers. Golem / Homunculus / Brazen Head / Wax Servitor Domain ChangeSets layer on top.

name: Colossus Base
notes: Chassis for Colossi: rare immense beings (dragons, kraken, leviathans) defined by overwhelming scale, force, dormancy, hunger, and catastrophic presence. Provides identity Tags and Traits plus three default powers. Dragon / Sea Colossus / Abyssal / Ancient Cunning ChangeSets layer on top.

name: Zone Base
notes: Chassis for Zone creatures: eerie stalking beings tied to warped pockets of reality, known more by signs and partial glimpses than clear sight. Provides identity Tags and Traits plus three default powers. Manifestation / Echo Person / Zone Predator / Warped Servitor / Boundary Haunter ChangeSets layer on top.

name: Zone Colossus Base
notes: Chassis for Zone Colossi: singular immense Zone beings (the severed hand, impossible disasters) defined by colossal scale fused with warped locality. Provides identity Tags and Traits plus three default powers. Severed Hand / Crawling Ruin / Watching Mass / Buried Colossus ChangeSets layer on top.

name: People Base
notes: Chassis for People: human opposition built as monster archetypes (guards, commoners, men-at-arms, knights, raiders) rather than full PC sheets. Provides identity Tags and Traits plus three default powers. Commoner / Guard / Raider / Man-at-Arms / Knight ChangeSets layer on top.

name: Natural Weapons (Beast)
notes: Loadout: body as weapon. Bite, claw, horn, tusk, trampling shape. +1 Strength and a Rending Bite power.

name: Heavy Body (Construct)
notes: Loadout: reinforced frame, blunt force, slow irresistible pressure. +1 Stamina and a Hammering Impact power.

name: Heavy Body (Undead)
notes: Loadout: corpse-mass, grave weight, unclean persistence. +1 Strength and a Drag Down power.

name: Heavy Body (Colossal)
notes: Loadout: catastrophic bulk rather than armor or agility. +1 Strength and a Ground-Shaking Step power.

name: Armed (People)
notes: Loadout: practical weapons, discipline, human martial readiness. +1 Dexterity and a Shield Bash power.

name: Armed (Undead)
notes: Loadout: burial-retained arms, battlefield remnants, dead hands still knowing violence. +1 Strength and a Rusting Cut power.

name: Armored (People)
notes: Loadout: trained fighters, guarded vital points, more confidence under pressure. +1 Stamina and a Brace Behind Armor power.

name: Armored (Undead)
notes: Loadout: armor that remained after death, heavy and uncanny in its persistence. +1 Stamina and a Shrug the Blow power.

name: Armored (Construct)
notes: Loadout: plated shell, reinforced joints, difficult-to-breach artificed protection. +1 Stamina and a Turn the Edge power.

name: Mounted (People)
notes: Loadout: horseman, raider, messenger, knight with speed and shock advantage. +2 MoveGround and a Ride Through power.

name: Mounted (TheUnseen)
notes: Loadout: impossible rider, hunt-rank, sovereign mounted presence. +2 MoveGround and a Ride Them Down power.

name: Ranged (People)
notes: Loadout: bows, crossbows, stones, thrown weapons handled by mortal skill. +1 Dexterity and a Loose the Shot power.

name: Ranged (Construct)
notes: Loadout: dart-projector, alchemical spitter, made thing designed for distance attack. +1 Power and a Launch the Dart power.

name: Ranged (Unnatural)
notes: Loadout: distance-force expressed through command, radiance, fire, or spiritual assault. +1 Power and a Judging Bolt power.

name: Swift Fragile (HiddenFolk)
notes: Loadout: quick, elusive, half-seen, hard to pin down. +1 Dexterity and a Slip Past the Gaze power.

name: Swift Fragile (Construct)
notes: Loadout: small made thing, quick assistant, thin frame, low staying power. +1 MoveGround / -1 Stamina and a Skitter Aside power.

name: Swift Fragile (Cursed)
notes: Loadout: transformed quickness, predatory reflex, unstable speed. +1 Dexterity and a Lunge in a Blur power.

name: Grasping (Undead)
notes: Loadout: dead hands, dragging grip, refusal to let the living free. +1 Strength and a Seize the Living power.

name: Grasping (Construct)
notes: Loadout: designed manipulator limbs, clamp-hands, tool-like holding force. +1 Strength and a Clamp and Hold power.

name: Grasping (ZoneColossus)
notes: Loadout: catastrophic grasp, crushing capture, horror of being taken by something too large to understand. +1 Power and a Colossal Grasp power.

name: Guardian (NatureSpirit)
notes: Defends grove, stream, homestead, or sacred patch. Warns before punishing. Grants Turn Back the Threat.

name: Guardian (People)
notes: Guard-post loyalty, watch duty, defense of charge or holding. Grants Stand the Post.

name: Guardian (Construct)
notes: Imposed warding function, no fear of harm to itself. Grants Hold to the Command.

name: Hunter (Beast)
notes: Prey-driven, instinctive, and physical. Grants Follow the Quarry.

name: Hunter (TheUnseen)
notes: Sovereign pursuit, chosen quarry, terrible inevitability. Grants Mark the Chosen Prey.

name: Hunter (Zone)
notes: Patient stalking, isolation pressure, sudden overtaking. Grants Never Lose the Trail.

name: Lurer (NatureSpirit)
notes: Misleads threats into water, bog, cold, roots, or getting lost. Grants Lead to the Bad Ground.

name: Lurer (Zone)
notes: False rescue, wrong voice, impossible near-at-hand pull. Grants Let Them Follow.

name: Lurer (HiddenFolk)
notes: Seduction, testing, mockery, or dangerous invitation under elder custom. Grants Offer the Wrong Welcome.

name: Territorial (Beast)
notes: Den, range, young, and feeding ground defense. Grants Drive from the Range.

name: Territorial (NatureSpirit)
notes: Place-bonded response to intrusion, damage, neglect, or desecration. Grants The Place Rejects You.

name: Territorial (HiddenFolk)
notes: Old claim, parallel possession, offense at trespass into overlapping ground. Grants Assert the Older Claim.

name: Vengeful (Undead)
notes: Unfinished grievance, return for a wrong, selective punishment. Grants Name the Wrongdoer.

name: Vengeful (Cursed)
notes: Curse-driven retaliation against maker, betrayer, or target-class. Grants Strike the One Who Caused This.

name: Vengeful (People)
notes: Feud, blood-price, revenge, or social wrong pursued into violence. Grants Settle the Wrong.

name: Hungry (Beast)
notes: Ordinary predation intensified by famine, season, or risk. Grants Commit to the Kill.

name: Hungry (Colossal)
notes: Catastrophe-beast feeding drive, ship-breaking appetite, disaster through need. Grants Feed at Any Cost.

name: Hungry (Undead)
notes: Life-force hunger, corpse-hunger, or warmth-hunger that overrides caution. Grants Devour the Living.

name: Protector of Kin (People)
notes: Household, children, spouse, band, or retainers defended at personal cost. Grants Step Between Them.

name: Protector of Kin (Beast)
notes: Young defense, mate defense, den-rage. Grants Defend the Young.

name: High Drive When Pressed (People)
notes: Mortal whose conviction hardens when kin, faith, oath, or honor is directly challenged. Drive guidance only — no granted power.

name: High Drive When Pressed (Undead)
notes: Unquiet dead becoming harder to turn aside when its grievance, grave, or unfinished purpose is named. Drive guidance only.

name: High Drive When Pressed (Unnatural)
notes: Outsider resolve intensifying when recruitment, command, doctrine, or factional purpose is resisted. Drive guidance only.

name: Recruiter (Unnatural)
notes: Active pressure to win allegiance rather than merely kill or frighten. Grants Offer the Side.

name: Preserve the Hidden Order (TheUnseen)
notes: Civilizational preservation, magical continuity, harsh judgment toward threats to the hidden order. Grants Command in the Name of the Old Order.

name: Await the Summons (Construct)
notes: Unnatural patience, dormancy, sudden total obedience once triggered. Grants Wake to Command.

name: Return to the House (Undead)
notes: Tragic repetition, domestic wrongness, attachment to household identity after death. Grants Resume the Old Habit.

name: Fulfill the Curse (Cursed)
notes: Inescapable compulsion, recurrence, partial loss of choice under imposed magical fate. Grants The Pattern Repeats.

name: Manifest the Zone (ZoneColossus)
notes: Not predation alone, but active making-real of warped locality at immense scale. Grants Bring the Wrongness With It.

name: Wood (HiddenFolk)
notes: Elder parallel inhabitants of forest margins and hidden paths. +1 MoveClimb, grants Lead Astray.

name: Wood (NatureSpirit)
notes: Skogsra, dryads, wood-wives, grove spirits. +2 MoveClimb, grants Turn the Path.

name: Wood (Beast)
notes: Wolves, boars, bears, dangerous woodland animals. +1 MoveGround, grants Break from the Brush.

name: Water (HiddenFolk)
notes: Brook-side and ford-dwelling hidden folk. MoveSwim 5, grants Mirror-Lure.

name: Water (NatureSpirit)
notes: River wives, ford spirits, spring maidens. MoveSwim 6, grants Beckoning Reflection.

name: Water (TheUnseen)
notes: Water sovereigns, ford maidens of high rank. MoveSwim 6, grants Drowning Summons.

name: Water (Colossal)
notes: Leviathans, kraken, immense sea-beasts. MoveSwim 7, grants Break the Hull.

name: Hill (HiddenFolk)
notes: Barrow folk, mound-dwellers, elder hill communities. +1 Faith, grants Barrow Glamour.

name: Hill (NatureSpirit)
notes: Hill trolls, cliff-haunters, old stone slope wardens. +1 Faith, grants Old Curse.

name: Hearth (HiddenFolk)
notes: Hidden folk pressing close against human hearth, hall, byre, and boundary. +1 Intelligence, grants Household Blessing.

name: Hearth (TheUnseen)
notes: Winter matrons, household judges, domestic sovereign powers. +1 Faith, grants Household Judgment.

name: Settlement (HiddenFolk)
notes: Hidden settlements overlapping roads, holdings, byres, lanes, village edges. +1 Intelligence, grants Spoil the Work.

name: Settlement (NatureSpirit)
notes: Tomte-like beings, farmstead guardians, shrine spirits. +1 Faith, grants Blessing of the Holding.

name: Settlement (People)
notes: Villagers, guards, thieves, town watch, retainers. +1 Charisma, grants Raise the Alarm.

name: Battlefield (People)
notes: Soldiers, mercenaries, raiders rooted in camp, march, and line of battle. +1 Stamina, grants Advance in Line.

name: Battlefield (Undead)
notes: Battle-dead, execution-dead, dead returning from slaughter fields. +1 Power, grants Rise Among the Fallen.

name: Deep Zone (Zone)
notes: Deep stalkers, manifestations of warped interiors. +1 Power, grants Erase the Track.

name: Deep Zone (ZoneColossus)
notes: Immense manifestations moving through the deep Zone as catastrophic anatomy. +1 Power, grants Tear Up the Ground.

name: Underground (HiddenFolk)
notes: Under-earth hidden folk, chamber-dwellers, tunnel-haunters. +1 Intelligence, grants Call Below.

name: Bog (NatureSpirit)
notes: Mire spirits, marsh-lights, fen wardens. +1 Stamina, grants Mire-Clutch.

name: Stone (NatureSpirit)
notes: Standing-stone wardens, cave-mouth beings, cairn spirits, stone-bound trolls. +1 Strength, grants Stone-Handed Blow.

name: Mountain (NatureSpirit)
notes: Highland spirits, avalanche wardens, summit presences. +3 MoveClimb, grants Avalanche Warning.

name: Corrupted (NatureSpirit)
notes: Blighted guardians, spirits whose bond to place has become poisoned. +1 Power, grants Lead Into Ruin.

name: Severed (NatureSpirit)
notes: Uprooted, displaced, land-lost spirits. +1 Power, grants Wander the Wrong Way.

name: Grave (Undead)
notes: Revenants, draugr, dead bound to mound, tomb, or churchyard. +1 Faith, grants Rise from the Grave.

name: Moon-Bound (Cursed)
notes: Werewolves, cyclical beast-transformations, night-ruled curse-beings. +1 Dexterity, grants Turn Under Moonlight.

name: Witch-Made (Cursed)
notes: Witch-made beasts, transformed toads/hares/dogs, curse-creatures by malediction. +1 Power, grants Mark of Malediction.

name: Infernal (Unnatural)
notes: Devils, contract-demons, tempters of hierarchy and corruption. +1 Charisma, grants Seal the Bargain.

name: Angelic (Unnatural)
notes: Cherubic war-servitors, seraphic messengers, rival faction powers of judgment. +1 Faith, grants Announce the Sentence.

name: Border Zone (Zone)
notes: Threshold stalkers, edge-haunters, wrong things at where the safe world thins. +1 Dexterity, grants Call from the Verge.

name: Golem (Construct)
notes: Clay guardians, laboring wards, letter-bound protectors. +1 Strength, grants Guard the Threshold.

name: Homunculus (Construct)
notes: Alchemical servants, whispering assistants, small artificial life-forms. +1 Dexterity, grants Whispering Service.

name: Brazen Head (Construct)
notes: Warded oracle heads, speaking gate relics, doom-speaking artifices. +1 Intelligence, grants Pronounce the Doom.

name: Wax Servitor (Construct)
notes: Likeness-dolls, witch-made helpers, hidden domestic spies. +1 Dexterity, grants Likeness Prick.

name: Courtly (TheUnseen)
notes: Sidhe nobles, fairy kings/queens, barrow-court royalty. +1 Charisma, grants Courtly Favor.

name: Hunt (TheUnseen)
notes: Erlking, leaders of the Wild Hunt, spectral riders of rank. +2 MoveGround, grants Mark the Quarry.

name: Smokeless Fire (TheUnseen)
notes: Jinn, ruin spirits of rank, beings of heat, smoke, bargain, invisible fire. +1 Power, grants Smoke Passage.

name: Winter (TheUnseen)
notes: Winter queens, snow matrons, rulers of sleep and harsh blessing. +1 Faith, grants Snow Blessing.

name: Half-Seen (HiddenFolk)
notes: Half-Seen — HiddenFolk variant. Grants Withdraw from Sight.

name: Half-Seen (Zone)
notes: Half-Seen — Zone variant. Grants Not Where You Thought.

name: Half-Seen (TheUnseen)
notes: Half-Seen — TheUnseen variant. Grants Look Away or Bow.

name: Easily Offended (HiddenFolk)
notes: Easily Offended — HiddenFolk variant. Grants Answer the Insult.

name: Easily Offended (NatureSpirit)
notes: Easily Offended — NatureSpirit variant. Grants Take Offense at the Harm.

name: Voice Like a Lure (NatureSpirit)
notes: Voice Like a Lure — NatureSpirit variant. Grants Call to the Water.

name: Voice Like a Lure (Zone)
notes: Voice Like a Lure — Zone variant. Grants Call from the Wrong Side.

name: Smells the Living (Beast)
notes: Smells the Living — Beast variant. Grants Follow the Blood-Scent.

name: Smells the Living (Undead)
notes: Smells the Living — Undead variant. Grants Find the Warm Heart.

name: Speaks in Bargains (TheUnseen)
notes: Speaks in Bargains — TheUnseen variant. Grants Name the Price.

name: Speaks in Bargains (Unnatural)
notes: Speaks in Bargains — Unnatural variant. Grants Close the Pact.

name: Restless (Undead)
notes: Restless — Undead variant. Grants Rise Again Too Soon.

name: Restless (Cursed)
notes: Restless — Cursed variant. Grants The Curse Stirs.

name: Protective of Its Own (Beast)
notes: Protective of Its Own — Beast variant. Grants Defend the Pack.

name: Protective of Its Own (People)
notes: Protective of Its Own — People variant. Grants Stand for Their Own.

name: Burned by Iron (HiddenFolk)
notes: Burned by Iron — HiddenFolk variant. Grants Recoil from Cold Iron.

name: Burned by Iron (NatureSpirit)
notes: Burned by Iron — NatureSpirit variant. Grants Shrink from the Worked Blade.

name: Burned by Iron (TheUnseen)
notes: Burned by Iron — TheUnseen variant. Grants Majesty Checked by Iron.

name: Must Be Invited (HiddenFolk)
notes: Must Be Invited — HiddenFolk variant. Grants Wait Beyond the Door.

name: Must Be Invited (Unnatural)
notes: Must Be Invited — Unnatural variant. Grants Cross on Welcome.

name: Must Be Invited (Undead)
notes: Must Be Invited — Undead variant. Grants Stand at the Lintel.

name: Cannot Be Fully Seen (Zone)
notes: Cannot Be Fully Seen — Zone variant. Grants Refuse Plain Sight.

name: Wrong Reflection (Unnatural)
notes: Wrong Reflection — Unnatural variant. Grants Show the Wrong Face.

name: Only by Night (Cursed)
notes: Only by Night — Cursed variant. Grants Vanish with the Sun.

name: Bound to the Grave-Gift (Undead)
notes: Bound to the Grave-Gift — Undead variant. Grants Reclaim the Gift.

name: Never Stops Watching (Construct)
notes: Never Stops Watching — Construct variant. Grants Eyes Always Open.

name: Too Large for Shelter (Colossal)
notes: Too Large for Shelter — Colossal variant. Grants Wreck the Doorway.

name: Strengthens in Moonlight (Cursed)
notes: Strengthens in Moonlight — Cursed variant. Grants Wax with the Moon.
